skill_name: Summarize the article "The Benefits of Eating Organic Food."
workflow: Organic food is food that has been grown and produced without the use of pesticides, chemical fertilizers, or genetic modifications. Eating organic food is beneficial because it provides higher levels of vitamins and minerals than non-organic food, is better for the environment, and can reduce exposure to toxic chemicals.
